reviewedDimensions: workspace domain integrity and transaction safety

findings.problem: Workspace digest excluded updatedAt and was checked only after referenced Timeline expansion.
findings.resolution: Bind updatedAt into the digest and reject an invalid digest before reading referenced Timeline files.

findings.problem: Duplicating a 64-item Workspace could write a 65th entry, fail on reload and leave the registry corrupted.
findings.resolution: Reject at the mutation boundary before creating a destination and roll back only files whose SHA still matches this invocation.

findings.problem: Workspace duplication did not recheck the source Timeline identity or its declared source-media SHA during cloning.
findings.resolution: Check Timeline SHA before and after read and validation; require current source-media identity on create, load, duplicate and Studio duplicate.

findings.problem: Moving a cloned Timeline into a versions subdirectory broke relative input paths and could reuse output/stem targets.
findings.resolution: Rebase relative input and evidence paths to the new owner file and create version-specific output and stem paths.

findings.problem: overwrite accepted a frame-aligned source range beyond the real source-media duration.
findings.resolution: Probe the bound source and reject sourceEnd beyond the media-duration tick before compiling mutations.

findings.problem: NLE output could remain orphaned if report creation failed after the exchange file was written.
findings.resolution: Use durable exclusive writes and remove only the invocation-owned matching-SHA output on report failure.

findings.problem: Self-contained bundle authorization deduplicated references by SHA before checking rights, allowing a licensed overlay to mask an unknown-license source with identical bytes.
findings.resolution: Authorize every reference independently, reject unknown/unverified license or provenance, then deduplicate only the physical copy by SHA.

findings.problem: Workspace allowed cross-project Timelines, non-primary ancestry without a parent and unchecked root timestamps.
findings.resolution: Require one projectId, primary-rooted ancestry and valid monotonic createdAt/updatedAt values.

findings.problem: Capability cards omitted implementation evidence and blocked counts while three drawers could remain stacked open.
findings.resolution: Render evidence and all status counts; make Capability, Delivery and Activity drawers mutually exclusive.

findings.problem: The 390px browser check reloaded to the unopened landing state and did not test the mobile workbench.
findings.resolution: Reopen the Workspace at 390x844, mount capability evidence, assert the full Timeline surface and verify zero document overflow.

findings.problem: Repository SKILL.md still documented Workbench V2 and omitted V3 workspace, capability and delivery truth boundaries.
findings.resolution: Update the repository skill contract to Workbench V3 commands and retain explicit plan-versus-rendered and target-NLE verification boundaries.

claimBoundary: All findings reproducible by this producer are closed locally. This is not independent final-review evidence and does not prove creator value, final rendered-media quality, target NLE import, remote CI or deployment.
